2026 ANNUAL INCENTIVE PLAN

Halbrook Diagnostics, Inc.
Approved by the Compensation Committee on February 10, 2026

1. PURPOSE. This Annual Incentive Plan (the "Plan") rewards eligible employees for the achievement of Company and individual performance goals for the plan year beginning January 1, 2026 and ending December 31, 2026 (the "Plan Year").

2. ELIGIBILITY. Full-time employees at grade 12 and above who are employed on or before October 1, 2026 are eligible. An employee hired after January 1, 2026 receives a pro-rated award based on days of eligible service. An employee who transfers between eligible positions during the Plan Year receives an award pro-rated between the two target percentages.

3. TARGET AWARDS. Each participant's target award is a percentage of eligible earnings, stated in the participant's award letter. "Eligible earnings" means base salary actually paid during the Plan Year, excluding overtime, prior-year bonuses, equity income, and imputed income.

4. PERFORMANCE MEASURES. The Company component is 70% of the target award and is measured on Adjusted EBITDA (40%), revenue (20%), and a quality composite of turnaround time and error rate (10%). The individual component is 30% and is measured against the participant's written objectives.

5. FUNDING AND PAYOUT CURVE. No award is funded unless Adjusted EBITDA reaches 90% of target (the "Threshold"). At Threshold the Company component pays at 50%; at target it pays at 100%; at 120% of target or above it pays at 200%, which is the maximum. Payout between points is interpolated on a straight line. The individual component may range from 0% to 150% and may not exceed the funded pool.

6. COMMITTEE DISCRETION. The Compensation Committee may adjust any award upward or downward, including to zero, and may adjust a performance measure for an acquisition, a divestiture, a change in accounting principle, or an extraordinary item. Any exercise of that discretion is documented in the Committee's minutes.

7. PAYMENT DATE AND EMPLOYMENT CONDITION. Awards are paid in a single cash lump sum, less applicable withholding, on or before March 15, 2027. A participant must be employed on the payment date to receive an award, except as Section 8 provides.

8. TERMINATION DURING THE PLAN YEAR. A participant who dies, becomes disabled, or retires at or after age 60 with ten years of service during the Plan Year receives a pro-rated award paid at the same time as other awards. A participant terminated without cause after September 30 receives a pro-rated award. A participant who resigns or is terminated for cause before the payment date forfeits the award.

9. SECTION 409A. Awards under this Plan are intended to be short-term deferrals exempt from Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code under Treasury Regulation § 1.409A-1(b)(4), and the Plan will be administered consistently with that intent. In no event may a participant designate the taxable year of payment.

10. CLAWBACK. Any award is subject to the Company's Compensation Recovery Policy and to any recovery required by Section 10D of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and the listing standards adopted under it.

11. NOT A CONTRACT OF EMPLOYMENT. This Plan does not create a contract of employment, does not alter the at-will employment relationship, and confers no right to continued employment or to any future award.

12. AMENDMENT AND TERMINATION. The Committee may amend, suspend, or terminate the Plan at any time. No amendment may reduce an award already earned and payable for a completed Plan Year.

13. UNFUNDED. The Plan is unfunded. A participant's right to an award is that of an unsecured general creditor of the Company.

14. GOVERNING LAW. Ohio law governs the Plan.
